name: robots/justagist__panda_simulator
title: Franka Emika Panda simulated hand
intro: Franka Emika Panda simulated hand, adapted from justagist/panda_simulator. It reads `finger_positions`; runs `move_gripper`, `grasp_gripper` and `stop_gripper`. `move_gripper`: send one franka_gripper/MoveAction goal with a finger opening and speed; the receipt reports the upstream action's terminal success, not a separately measured contact force. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
